rationale: Revision 1fe1bfe6a4e39975a5a4150a7e58aa14e37ceb6f closes both round-2 revise findings with regression tests — dependency identity now hashes the real installed files under node_modules/.pnpm with the worktree path normalized and escaping links refused (two fresh frozen installs hashed identically, lint/typecheck/vitest left it unchanged, a tampered byte changed it), and a cache probe that edits tracked files now fails the gate instead of reusing a receipt — with check:fast (620 fast + 177 system tests) and the push-hook e2e passing at commit and push.
